Overview

Dehradun is a city in Uttarakhand with a population of 800,000. The capital of Uttarakhand, a scenic valley city at the foothills of the Himalayas, known for its boarding schools and natural beauty. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
